title: Reel of the Damned
description: A woman with purple hair in a green coat is violently pulled by a large black horse emerging from a shattered golden picture frame. The horse is entangled in burning film reels and strips while the woman clutches the film, her mouth open in a scream. The ornate hall floor is covered in broken film reels, cans, and debris under dramatic beams of light.
prompt: A dramatic surreal scene inside a grand decaying hall with ornate tiled floors. A large powerful black horse bursts through a shattered golden picture frame, its body wrapped in burning film strips that read REEL and FOLLOW. A woman with wild purple hair wearing a long green coat is being dragged by the horse, clutching the film reels with an expression of terror. Broken film reels, cans, and debris are scattered across the wet floor. Dramatic god rays pierce through the dusty air from above.
